people.descriptor: Crown Prince and Royal Family Member
Imperial Grandson and Royal Family Member

work.en: Five Eulogies on the Avatamsaka Sutra

label.en: administrator of Northern Court great king affairs

reason.en: forged an edict to build a private residence

sourceDate.text: 大康元年十二月己丑朔
大康元年十二月己丑朔
大康元年十二月己丑朔

units.zh: 道宗三
units.en: Daozong, Part Three
units.literal: Daozong, Part Three

units.zh: 八年春正月癸未，烏古敵烈部詳穩耶律巢等奏克北邊捷。
units.en: In the eighth year, on guiwei day of the first spring month Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao and others memorialized victory on the northern border.
units.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on guiwei day, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao and others memorialized victory on the northern border.

units.zh: 以戰多殺人，飯僧南京、中京。
units.en: Because the fighting had killed many, monks were fed at Nanjing and the Central Capital.
units.literal: Because the fighting had killed many, monks were fed at Nanjing and the Central Capital.

units.zh: 甲申，如魚兒濼。
units.en: On jiashen day the court went to Yuer Marsh.
units.literal: On jiashen day went to Yuer Marsh.

units.zh: 壬寅，昏霧連日。
units.en: On renyin day dull fog lasted many days.
units.literal: On renyin day dull fog lasted many days.

units.zh: 二月丙辰，北、南樞密院言無事可陳。
units.en: On bingchen day of the second month the Northern and Southern Privy Councils said there was nothing to memorialize.
units.literal: Second month, on bingchen day Northern and Southern Privy Councils said there was nothing to memorialize.

units.zh: 壬戌，以討北部功，烏古敵烈部詳穩耶律巢知北院大王事，都監蕭阿魯帶烏古敵烈部詳穩，加左監門衛上將軍。
units.en: On renxu day, for merit in attacking the northern tribes, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao was made to administer Northern Court great king affairs; inspector-general Xiao Aludai was made Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable and promoted Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.
units.literal: On renxu day, for merit in attacking the northern tribes, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao was made to administer Northern Court great king affairs; inspector-general Xiao Aludai Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable, promoted Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.

units.zh: 戊辰，歲饑，免武安州租稅，振恩、蔚、順、惠等州民。
units.en: On wuchen day there was famine that year; Wuan Prefecture rent and tax were remitted, and people in En, Yu, Shun, and Hui prefectures were relieved.
units.literal: On wuchen day there was famine that year; Wuan Prefecture rent and tax were remitted, and people in En, Yu, Shun, and Hui prefectures were relieved.

units.zh: 三月癸卯，有司奏春、泰、寧江三州三千餘人願為僧尼，受具足戒，許之。
units.en: On guimao day of the third month the relevant offices memorialized that more than three thousand people in Chun, Tai, and Ningjiang prefectures wished to become monks and nuns and receive full precepts; permission was granted.
units.literal: Third month, on guimao day the relevant offices memorialized that more than three thousand people in Chun, Tai, and Ningjiang prefectures wished to become monks and nuns and receive full precepts; permitted.

units.zh: 夏四月壬子，振義、饒二州民。
units.en: On renzi day of the fourth summer month people in Yi and Rao prefectures were relieved.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renzi day, relieved people in Yi and Rao prefectures.

units.zh: 丁巳，駐蹕塔裏舍。
units.en: On dingsi day the court halted at Talishe.
units.literal: On dingsi day halted at Talishe.

units.zh: 己卯，清暑拖古烈。
units.en: On jimao day the court summered at Tuogulie.
units.literal: On jimao day summered at Tuogulie.

units.zh: 五月壬午，晉王仁先薨。
units.en: On renwu day of the fifth month Prince of Jin Renxian died.
units.literal: Fifth month, on renwu day Prince of Jin Renxian died.

units.zh: 六月甲寅，振易州貧民。
units.en: On jiayin day of the sixth month poor people in Yi Prefecture were relieved.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin day, relieved poor people in Yi Prefecture.

units.zh: 己未，振中京。
units.en: On jiwei day the Central Capital was relieved.
units.literal: On jiwei day relieved the Central Capital.

units.zh: 甲子，振興中府。
units.en: On jiazi day Xingzhong Prefecture was relieved.
units.literal: On jiazi day relieved Xingzhong Prefecture.

units.zh: 甲戌，封北府宰相楊績為趙王，樞密副使耶律觀參知政事兼知南院樞密使事。
units.en: On jiaxu day Northern Court chancellor Yang Ji was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; associate privy commissioner Yelü Guan was made Associate Administrator of Affairs and administrator of Southern Court privy affairs.
units.literal: On jiaxu day Northern Court chancellor Yang Ji was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; associate privy commissioner Yelü Guan Associate Administrator of Affairs and administrator of Southern Court privy affairs.

units.zh: 丁丑，高麗遣使來貢。
units.en: On dingchou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On dingchou day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 秋七月己卯，慶州靳文高八世同居，詔賜爵。
units.en: On jimao day of the seventh autumn month, in Qing Prefecture Jin Wengao's eight generations lived together; an edict granted rank.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jimao day, in Qing Prefecture Jin Wen's eight generations lived together; edict granted rank.

units.zh: 丙申，振饒州饑民。
units.en: On bingshen day hungry people in Rao Prefecture were relieved.
units.literal: On bingshen day relieved hungry people in Rao Prefecture.

units.zh: 丁酉，幸黑嶺。
units.en: On dingyou day the court visited Heiling.
units.literal: On dingyou day visited Heiling.

units.zh: 丁未，以御書《華嚴經五頌》出示群臣。
units.en: On dingwei day the imperial composition 《Five Eulogies on the Avatamsaka Sutra》 was shown to the ministers.
units.literal: On dingwei day the imperial composition 《Five Eulogies on the Avatamsaka Sutra》 was shown to the ministers.

units.zh: 閏月辛未，射熊於羖羊山。
units.en: In the intercalary month, on xinwei day, a bear was shot at Guyang Mountain.
units.literal: Intercalary month, on xinwei day, shot a bear at Guyang Mountain.

units.zh: 八月庚辰，混同郡王侯古薨，遣使致祭。
units.en: On gengchen day of the eighth month Prince of Huntong Commandery Hougu died; envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice.
units.literal: Eighth month, on gengchen day Prince of Huntong Commandery Hougu died; envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice.

units.zh: 九月甲子，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: On jiazi day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Ninth month, on jiazi day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 冬十月己丑，參知政事耶律觀矯制營私第，降為庶人。
units.en: On jichou day of the tenth winter month Associate Administrator of Affairs Yelü Guan forged an edict to build a private residence and was demoted to commoner.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jichou day Associate Administrator of Affairs Yelü Guan forged an edict to build a private residence and was demoted to commoner.

units.zh: 癸巳，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On guisi day Uighur came with tribute.
units.literal: On guisi day Uighur came with tribute.

units.zh: 十一庚戌，免祖州稅。
units.en: On gengxu day of the eleventh month Zu Prefecture tax was remitted.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on gengxu day, remitted Zu Prefecture tax.

units.zh: 丙辰，大雪，許民樵采禁地。
units.en: On bingchen day heavy snow fell; the people were permitted to gather firewood in forbidden grounds.
units.literal: On bingchen day heavy snow fell; the people were permitted to gather firewood in forbidden grounds.

units.zh: 丁卯，賜延昌宮貧戶錢。
units.en: On dingmao day money was bestowed on poor households of Yanchang Palace.
units.literal: On dingmao day money was bestowed on poor households of Yanchang Palace.

units.zh: 十二月戊辰，漢人行宮都部署耶律仲禧封韓國公，樞密副使、參知政事趙徽出為武定軍節度使，樞密副使柴德滋參知政事，漢人行宮副部署耶律大悲奴升都部署，同知南院樞密使事蕭韓家奴知左夷離畢事。
units.en: On wuchen day of the twelfth month Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Zhongxi was enfeoffed Duke of Han; associate privy commissioner and Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Hui was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Chai Dezi was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Yelü Dabeinu was promoted deployment director; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made administrator of Left yilibi affairs.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on wuchen day Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Zhongxi was enfeoffed Duke of Han; associate privy commissioner and Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Hui was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Chai Dezi Associate Administrator of Affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Yelü Dabeinu was promoted deployment director; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu administrator of Left yilibi affairs.

units.zh: 丁，以坤寧節，大赦。
units.en: On a ding day, because of the Kunning Festival, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: On a ding day, because of the Kunning Festival, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 庚寅，賜高麗佛經一藏。
units.en: On gengyin day one complete canon of Buddhist scriptures was bestowed on Goryeo.
units.literal: On gengyin day one complete canon of Buddhist scriptures was bestowed on Goryeo.

units.zh: 九年春正月丁未，如雙濼。
units.en: In the ninth year, on dingwei day of the first spring month the court went to Shuang Marsh.
units.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on dingwei day, went to Shuang Marsh.

units.zh: 夏四月壬辰，如旺國崖。
units.en: On renchen day of the fourth summer month the court went to Wangguo Cliff.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renchen day, went to Wangguo Cliff.

units.zh: 秋七月甲辰，獵大熊山。
units.en: On jiachen day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Daxiong Mountain.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen day, hunted at Daxiong Mountain.

units.zh: 戊申，烏古敵烈統軍言，八石烈敵烈人殺其節度使以叛。
units.en: On wushen day Wugu Dilie supreme commander memorialized that Eight Shilie Dilie people had killed their military commissioner and rebelled.
units.literal: On wushen day Wugu Dilie supreme commander memorialized that Eight Shilie Dilie people had killed their military commissioner and rebelled.

units.zh: 己酉，詔隗烏古部軍分道擊之。
units.en: On jiyou day an edict ordered Kui Wugu tribal troops to attack on separate routes.
units.literal: On jiyou day edict ordered Kui Wugu tribal troops to attack on separate routes.

units.zh: 丙寅，南京奏歸義。
units.en: On bingyin day Nanjing memorialized Guiyi.
units.literal: On bingyin day Nanjing memorialized Guiyi.

units.zh: 淶水兩縣蝗飛入宋境，餘為蜂所食。
units.en: In Lishui two counties locusts flew into Song territory; the remainder were eaten by wasps.
units.literal: In Lishui two counties locusts flew into Song territory; the remainder were eaten by wasps.

units.zh: 八月丙申，以耶律仲禧為南院樞密使。
units.en: On bingshen day of the eighth month Yelü Zhongxi was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
units.literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day Yelü Zhongxi was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

units.zh: 九月癸卯，駐蹕獨盧金。
units.en: On guimao day of the ninth month the court halted at Dulujin.
units.literal: Ninth month, on guimao day, halted at Dulujin.

units.zh: 冬十月，幸陰山，遂如西京。
units.en: In the tenth winter month the court visited Yin Mountain, then went to the Western Capital.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, visited Yin Mountain, then went to the Western Capital.

units.zh: 十一月戊午，詔行幸之地免租一年。
units.en: On wuwu day of the eleventh month an edict ordered that places the court visited were exempt from rent for one year.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on wuwu day, edict ordered that places the court visited were exempt from rent for one year.

units.zh: 甲子，南院大王合理只致仕。
units.en: On jiazi day Southern Court great king Helizhi retired.
units.literal: On jiazi day Southern Court great king Helizhi retired.

units.zh: 十二月辛未，以知北院樞密使事耶律宜新為中京留守，南院宣徽使耶律撒剌為南院大王。
units.en: On xinwei day of the twelfth month Yelü Yixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made regent of the Central Capital; Southern Court palace commissioner Yelü Sala was made Southern Court great king.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on xinwei day Yelü Yixin, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made regent of the Central Capital; Southern Court palace commissioner Yelü Sala Southern Court great king.

units.zh: 壬辰，高麗、夏國並遣使來貢。
units.en: On renchen day Goryeo and Xia State both sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On renchen day Goryeo and Xia State both dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 十年春正月乙卯，如鴛鴦濼。
units.en: In the tenth year, on yimao day of the first spring month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
units.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on yimao day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.

units.zh: 二月癸未，蠲平州復業民租賦。
units.en: On guiwei day of the second month rent and tax for Ping Prefecture households resuming cultivation were remitted.
units.literal: Second month, on guiwei day, remitted rent and tax for Ping Prefecture households resuming cultivation.

units.zh: 戊子，阻卜來貢。
units.en: On wuzi day Zubu came with tribute.
units.literal: On wuzi day Zubu came with tribute.

units.zh: 三月甲子，如拖古烈。
units.en: On jiazi day of the third month the court went to Tuogulie.
units.literal: Third month, on jiazi day, went to Tuogulie.

units.zh: 以耶律巢為北院大王。
units.en: Yelü Chao was made Northern Court great king.
units.literal: Yelü Chao was made Northern Court great king.

units.zh: 夏四月，旱。
units.en: In the fourth summer month there was drought.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, drought.

units.zh: 辛未，以奚人達魯三世同居，賜官旌之。
units.en: On xinwei day, because Xi man Dalu's three generations lived together, office was granted to honor him.
units.literal: On xinwei day, because Xi man Dalu's three generations lived together, office was granted to honor him.

units.zh: 五月丙寅，錄囚。
units.en: On bingyin day of the fifth month prisoners were reviewed.
units.literal: Fifth month, on bingyin day, reviewed prisoners.

units.zh: 六月戊辰，親出題試進士。
units.en: On wuchen day of the sixth month the Emperor personally set topics to test jinshi.
units.literal: Sixth month, on wuchen day, the Emperor personally set topics to test jinshi.

units.zh: 壬申，詔臣庶言得失。
units.en: On renshen day an edict ordered ministers and commoners to speak on gains and losses.
units.literal: On renshen day, edict ordered ministers and commoners to speak on gains and losses.

units.zh: 丙子，禦永安殿，策賢良。
units.en: On bingzi day at Yong'an Hall worthy and good men were tested.
units.literal: On bingzi day at Yong'an Hall tested worthy and good men.

units.zh: 秋七月丙辰，如秋山。
units.en: On bingchen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day, went to autumn mountains.

units.zh: 癸亥，謁慶陵。
units.en: On guihai day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
units.literal: On guihai day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 九月庚戌，幸東京，謁二儀、五鸞殿。
units.en: On gengxu day of the ninth month the court visited the Eastern Capital and paid respects at the Two Principles and Five Phoenix halls.
units.literal: Ninth month, on gengxu day, visited the Eastern Capital and paid respects at the Two Principles and Five Phoenix halls.

units.zh: 癸亥，祠木葉山。
units.en: On guihai day sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.
units.literal: On guihai day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.

units.zh: 冬十月丁卯，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: On dingmao day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingmao day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 丁丑，詔有司頒行《史記》、《漢書》。
units.en: On dingchou day an edict ordered the relevant offices to promulgate the 《Records of the Grand Historian》 and 《Book of Han》.
units.literal: On dingchou day, edict ordered the relevant offices to promulgate the 《Records of the Grand Historian》 and 《Book of Han》.

units.zh: 十一月戊午，高麗遣使來貢。
units.en: On wuwu day of the eleventh month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on wuwu day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 十二月辛巳，改明年為大康，大赦。
units.en: On xinsi day of the twelfth month the coming year was changed to Dikang and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on xinsi day the coming year was changed to Dikang and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 大康元年春正月乙未，如混同江。
units.en: In the first year of Dikang, on yiwei day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
units.literal: In the first year of Dikang, spring, first month, on yiwei day, went to the Huntong River.

units.zh: 壬寅，振雲州饑。
units.en: On renyin day famine in Yun Prefecture was relieved.
units.literal: On renyin day relieved famine in Yun Prefecture.

units.zh: 二月丁卯，祥州火，遣使恤災。
units.en: On dingmao day of the second month Xiang Prefecture caught fire; envoys were dispatched to comfort the disaster.
units.literal: Second month, on dingmao day Xiang Prefecture caught fire; envoys were dispatched to comfort the disaster.

units.zh: 乙酉，駐蹕大魚濼。
units.en: On yiyou day the court halted at Dayu Marsh.
units.literal: On yiyou day halted at Dayu Marsh.

units.zh: 丁亥，以獲鵝，加鷹坊使耶律楊六為工部尚書。
units.en: On dinghai day, because geese were obtained, hawk-mews commissioner Yelü Yangliu was promoted Minister of Works.
units.literal: On dinghai day, because geese were obtained, hawk-mews commissioner Yelü Yangliu was promoted Minister of Works.

units.zh: 三月乙巳，命皇太子寫佛書。
units.en: On yisi day of the third month the crown prince was ordered to copy Buddhist books.
units.literal: Third month, on yisi day, ordered the crown prince to copy Buddhist books.

units.zh: 夏四月丙子，振平州饑。
units.en: On bingzi day of the fourth summer month famine in Ping Prefecture was relieved.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingzi day, relieved famine in Ping Prefecture.

units.zh: 己酉，如犢山閏月丙午，振平、灤二州饑。
units.en: On jiyou day the court went to Du Mountain; in the intercalary month, on bingwu day, famine in Ping and Luan prefectures was relieved.
units.literal: On jiyou day went to Du Mountain; intercalary month, on bingwu day, relieved famine in Ping and Luan prefectures.

units.zh: 庚戌，皇孫延禧生。
units.en: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.
units.literal: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.

units.zh: 五月甲子，賜妃之親及東宮僚屬爵有差。
units.en: On jiazi day of the fifth month rank was granted by degree to the consort's kin and Eastern Palace staff.
units.literal: Fifth month, on jiazi day rank was granted by degree to the consort's kin and Eastern Palace staff.

units.zh: 六月癸巳，以興聖宮使奚謝家奴知奚六部大王事。
units.en: On guisi day of the sixth month Xing Sheng Palace commissioner Xi Xiejianu was made to administer Xi Six Tribes great king affairs.
units.literal: Sixth month, on guisi day Xing Sheng Palace commissioner Xi Xiejianu was made to administer Xi Six Tribes great king affairs.

units.zh: 戊戌，知三司使事韓操以錢谷增羨，授三司使。
units.en: On wuxu day Han Cao, who administered Three Departments affairs, because money and grain increased was appointed Three Departments commissioner.
units.literal: On wuxu day Han Cao, who administered Three Departments affairs, because money and grain increased was appointed Three Departments commissioner.

units.zh: 癸卯，遣使按問諸路囚。
units.en: On guimao day envoys were dispatched to investigate prisoners in all routes.
units.literal: On guimao day dispatched envoys to investigate prisoners in all routes.

units.zh: 以惕隱大悲奴為始平軍節度使，參知政事柴德滋武定軍節度使。
units.en: Tiyin Dabeinu was made military commissioner of Shiping Army; Associate Administrator of Affairs Chai Dezi military commissioner of Wuding Army.
units.literal: Tiyin Dabeinu was made military commissioner of Shiping Army; Associate Administrator of Affairs Chai Dezi military commissioner of Wuding Army.

units.zh: 乙卯，吐蕃來貢。
units.en: On yimao day Tibet came with tribute.
units.literal: On yimao day Tibet came with tribute.

units.zh: 丙辰，詔皇太子總領朝政，仍戒諭之。
units.en: On bingchen day an edict ordered the crown prince to oversee court government in general, and he was admonished.
units.literal: On bingchen day, edict ordered the crown prince to oversee court government in general, and he was admonished.

units.zh: 以武定軍節度使趙徽為南府宰相，樞密副使楊遵勖參知政事。
units.en: Wuding Army military commissioner Zhao Hui was made Southern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yang Zunxu was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: Wuding Army military commissioner Zhao Hui was made Southern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yang Zunxu Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 秋七月辛酉朔，獵平地松林。
units.en: On the xinyou new moon of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou new moon, hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

units.zh: 丙寅，振南京貧民。
units.en: On bingyin day poor people in Nanjing were relieved.
units.literal: On bingyin day relieved poor people in Nanjing.

units.zh: 八月庚寅朔，日有食之。
units.en: On the gengyin new moon of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: Eighth month, on gengyin new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 九月乙亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: On yihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Ninth month, on yihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 己卯，以南京饑，免租稅一年，仍出錢粟振之。
units.en: On jimao day, because Nanjing had famine, rent and tax were remitted for one year and money and grain were issued for relief.
units.literal: On jimao day, because Nanjing had famine, rent and tax were remitted for one year and money and grain were issued for relief.

units.zh: 冬十月，西北路酋長遐搭、雛搭、雙古等來降。
units.en: In the tenth winter month Northwest Route chieftains Xiadá, Choudá, Shuanggu, and others came to surrender.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Northwest Route chieftains Xiadá, Choudá, Shuanggu, and others came to surrender.

units.zh: 十一月辛酉，皇后被誣，賜死；
units.en: On xinyou day of the eleventh month the Empress was slandered and ordered to die;
units.literal: Eleventh month, on xinyou day the Empress was slandered and ordered to die;

units.zh: 殺伶人趙惟一、高長命，並籍其家屬。
units.en: The musicians Zhao Weiyi and Gao Changming were killed, and their families were registered and confiscated.
units.literal: musicians Zhao Weiyi and Gao Changming were killed, and their families were registered and confiscated.

units.zh: 十二月己丑朔，以南京統軍使耶律魘奴為惕隱，漢人行宮都部署耶律霂樞密副使，同知東京留守事蕭鐸剌夷離畢。
units.en: On the jichou new moon of the twelfth month Nanjing supreme commander Yelü Yannu was made tiyin; Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Li was made associate privy commissioner; associate Eastern Capital regent Xiao Telaci was made yilibi.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jichou new moon, Nanjing supreme commander Yelü Yannu was made tiyin; Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Li associate privy commissioner; associate Eastern Capital regent Xiao Telaci yilibi.

units.zh: 庚寅，賜張孝傑國姓。
units.en: On gengyin day Zhang Xiaojie was granted the imperial clan surname.
units.literal: On gengyin day Zhang Xiaojie was granted the imperial clan surname.

units.zh: 壬辰，以西京留守蕭燕六為左夷離畢。
units.en: On renchen day Western Capital regent Xiao Yanliu was made Left yilibi.
units.literal: On renchen day Western Capital regent Xiao Yanliu was made Left yilibi.

units.zh: 二年春正月己未，如春水。
units.en: In the second year, on jiwei day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on jiwei day, went to spring waters.

units.zh: 庚辰，駐蹕雙濼。
units.en: On gengchen day the court halted at Shuang Marsh.
units.literal: On gengchen day halted at Shuang Marsh.

units.zh: 二月戊子，振黃龍府饑。
units.en: On wuzi day of the second month famine in Huanglong Prefecture was relieved.
units.literal: Second month, on wuzi day relieved famine in Huanglong Prefecture.

units.zh: 癸丑，南京路饑，免租稅一年。
units.en: On guichou day Nanjing Route had famine; rent and tax were remitted for one year.
units.literal: On guichou day Nanjing Route had famine; rent and tax were remitted for one year.

units.zh: 三月辛酉，皇太后崩。
units.en: On xinyou day of the third month the Empress Dowager died.
units.literal: Third month, on xinyou day the Empress Dowager died.

units.zh: 壬戌，遣殿前副點檢耶律轄古報哀於宋。
units.en: On renxu day Palace Front deputy commander Yelü Xiagu was dispatched to announce the mourning to Song.
units.literal: On renxu day dispatched Palace Front deputy commander Yelü Xiagu to announce the mourning to Song.

units.zh: 癸亥，遣使報哀於高麗、夏國。
units.en: On guihai day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Goryeo and Xia State.
units.literal: On guihai day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Goryeo and Xia State.

units.zh: 丁卯，大赦。
units.en: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 戊寅，以皇太后遺物遣使遺宋、夏。
units.en: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched with the Empress Dowager's bequeathed goods as gifts to Song and Xia.
units.literal: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched with the Empress Dowager's bequeathed goods as gifts to Song and Xia.

units.zh: 夏六月乙酉朔，上大行皇太后尊謚曰仁懿皇后。
units.en: On the yiyou new moon of the sixth summer month the posthumous honorific for the late Empress Dowager was Empress Rende.
units.literal: Summer, sixth month, on yiyou new moon, posthumous honorific for the late Empress Dowager: Empress Rende.

units.zh: 戊子，宋及高麗、夏國各遣使吊祭。
units.en: On wuzi day Song and Goryeo and Xia State each sent envoys to offer condolences.
units.literal: On wuzi day Song and Goryeo and Xia State each dispatched envoys to offer condolences.

units.zh: 甲午，葬仁懿皇后於慶陵。
units.en: On jiawu day Empress Rende was buried at Qing Mausoleum.
units.literal: On jiawu day buried Empress Rende at Qing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 己亥，駐蹕拖古烈。
units.en: On jihai day the court halted at Tuogulie.
units.literal: On jihai day halted at Tuogulie.

units.zh: 壬寅，出北院樞密使魏王耶律乙辛為中京留守。
units.en: On renyin day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was dismissed as regent of the Central Capital.
units.literal: On renyin day dismissed Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin as regent of the Central Capital.

units.zh: 丁未，冊皇后蕭氏，封其父祗候郎君鱉裏剌為趙王，叔西北路招討使餘里也遼西郡王，兄漢人行宮都部署、駙馬都慰霞抹柳城郡王，參知政事楊遵勖知南院樞密使事，北院樞密使副蕭速撒知北院樞密使事，漢人行宮副部署劉詵參知政事。
units.en: On dingwei day Empress Xiao was invested; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu was made administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: On dingwei day invested Empress Xiao; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 己酉，南府宰相趙徽致仕。
units.en: On jiyou day Southern Court chancellor Zhao Hui retired.
units.literal: On jiyou day Southern Court chancellor Zhao Hui retired.

units.zh: 秋七月戊辰，如秋山。
units.en: On wuchen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day went to autumn mountains.

units.zh: 癸酉，柳城郡王霞抹薨。
units.en: On guiyou day Prince of Liucheng Xiamo died.
units.literal: On guiyou day Prince of Liucheng Xiamo died.

units.zh: 八月庚寅，獵，遇麛失其母，憫之，不射。
units.en: On gengyin day of the eighth month the court hunted; encountering a fawn that had lost its mother, the Emperor pitied it and did not shoot.
units.literal: Eighth month, on gengyin day hunted; encountering a fawn that had lost its mother, he pitied it and did not shoot.

units.zh: 九月戊午，以南京蝗，免明年租稅。
units.en: On wuwu day of the ninth month, because Nanjing had locusts, next year's rent and tax were remitted.
units.literal: Ninth month, on wuwu day, because Nanjing had locusts, next year's rent and tax were remitted.

units.zh: 己卯，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: On jimao day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: On jimao day halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 冬十月戊戌，召中京留守魏王耶律乙辛復為北院樞密使。
units.en: On wuxu day of the tenth winter month Central Capital regent Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was summoned back as Northern Court privy commissioner.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu day summoned Central Capital regent Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin back as Northern Court privy commissioner.

units.zh: 十一月甲戌，上欲觀《起居註》，修註郎不攧及忽突堇等不進，各杖二百，罷之。
units.en: On jiaxu day of the eleventh month the Emperor wished to view the 《Diary of Actions and Repose》; revising annotator Budian and Hutujin and others did not present it; each was beaten two hundred strokes and dismissed.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day the Emperor wished to view the 《Diary of Actions and Repose》; revising annotator Budian and Hutujin and others did not present it; each was beaten two hundred strokes and dismissed.

units.zh: 流林牙蕭巖壽於烏隗部。
units.en: Linya Xiao Yanshou was exiled to the Wuhui tribe.
units.literal: Linya Xiao Yanshou was exiled to the Wuhui tribe.

units.zh: 是月，南京地震，民舍多壞。
units.en: That month Nanjing had an earthquake; many commoners' houses were destroyed.
units.literal: That month Nanjing had an earthquake; many commoners' houses were destroyed.

units.zh: 十二月己丑，以左夷離畢蕭撻不也為南京統軍使。
units.en: On jichou day of the twelfth month Left yilibi Xiao Tabuye was made Nanjing supreme commander.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jichou day Left yilibi Xiao Tabuye was made Nanjing supreme commander.

units.zh: 三年春正月癸丑，如混同江。
units.en: In the third year, on guichou day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on guichou day, went to the Huntong River.

units.zh: 乙卯，省諸道春貢金帛，及停周歲所輸尚方銀。
units.en: On yimao day spring tribute of gold and silk in all routes was reduced and yearly silver tribute to the imperial workshop was stopped.
units.literal: On yimao day reduced spring tribute of gold and silk in all routes and stopped yearly silver tribute to the imperial workshop.

units.zh: 二月壬午朔，東北路統軍使蕭韓家奴加尚父，封吳王。
units.en: On the renwu new moon of the second month Eastern Route supreme commander Xiao Hanjianu was honored imperial father and enfeoffed Prince of Wu.
units.literal: Second month, on renwu new moon, Eastern Route supreme commander Xiao Hanjianu was honored imperial father and enfeoffed Prince of Wu.

units.zh: 甲申，詔北院樞密使魏王耶律乙辛同母兄大奴、同母弟阿思世預北、南院樞密之選，其異母諸弟世預夷離堇之選。
units.en: On jiashen day an edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.
units.literal: On jiashen day, edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.

units.zh: 己丑，如魚兒濼。
units.en: On jichou day the court went to Yuer Marsh.
units.literal: On jichou day went to Yuer Marsh.

units.zh: 辛卯，中京饑，罷巡幸。
units.en: On xinmao day the Central Capital had famine; the tour was stopped.
units.literal: On xinmao day the Central Capital had famine; the tour was stopped.

units.zh: 夏四月乙酉，泛舟黑龍江。
units.en: On yiyou day of the fourth summer month the court boated on the Black Dragon River.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yiyou day boated on the Black Dragon River.

units.zh: 五月丙辰，玉田、安次蝝，傷稼。
units.en: On bingchen day of the fifth month Yutian and Anci had aphids that injured the crops.
units.literal: Fifth month, on bingchen day Yutian and Anci had aphids that injured the crops.

units.zh: 癸亥，日中有黑子。
units.en: On guihai day there was a black spot in the sun.
units.literal: On guihai day there was a black spot in the sun.

units.zh: 己巳，駐蹕犢山。
units.en: On jisi day the court halted at Du Mountain.
units.literal: On jisi day halted at Du Mountain.

units.zh: 乙亥，北院樞密使耶律乙辛奏，右護衛太保查剌等告知北院樞密使事蕭速撒等八人謀立皇太子，上以無狀，不治，出速撒等三人補外，護衛撒撥等六人各鞭百餘，徙於邊。
units.en: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.
units.literal: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.

units.zh: 丙子，以西北路招討使遼西郡王蕭餘里也為北府宰相，兼知契丹行宮都部署事。
units.en: On bingzi day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northern Court chancellor and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.
units.literal: On bingzi day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northern Court chancellor and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.

units.zh: 戊寅，詔告謀逆事者，重加官賞。
units.en: On wuyin day an edict announced that those who reported plotting rebellion would be heavily rewarded with office.
units.literal: On wuyin day, edict announced that those who reported plotting rebellion would be heavily rewarded with office.

units.zh: 六月己卯朔，耶律乙辛令牌印郎君蕭訛都斡誣首嘗預速撒等謀，籍其姓名以告。
units.en: On the jimao new moon of the sixth month Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jimao new moon, Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.

units.zh: 即命乙辛及耶律仲禧、蕭餘里也、耶律孝傑、楊遵勖、燕哥、抄只、蕭十三等鞫治，杖皇太子，囚之宮中。
units.en: Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others were immediately ordered to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.
units.literal: Immediately ordered Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.

units.zh: 辛巳，殺宿直官敵裏剌等三人。
units.en: On xinsi day three night-duty officials including Dirili were killed.
units.literal: On xinsi day killed three night-duty officials including Dirili.

units.zh: 壬午，殺宣徽使撻不也等二人。
units.en: On renwu day two including palace commissioner Tabuye were killed.
units.literal: On renwu day killed two including palace commissioner Tabuye.

units.zh: 癸未，殺始平軍節度使撒剌等十人，又遣使殺上京留守速撒，及已徙護衛撒撥等六人。
units.en: On guimao day ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala were killed; envoys were also dispatched to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.
units.literal: On guimao day killed ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala; also dispatched envoys to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.

units.zh: 乙酉，殺耶律撻不也及其弟陳留。
units.en: On yiyou day Yelü Tabuye and his younger brother Chenliu were killed.
units.literal: On yiyou day killed Yelü Tabuye and his younger brother Chenliu.

units.zh: 丙戌，廢皇太子為庶人，囚之上京。
units.en: On bingxu day the crown prince was deposed as commoner and imprisoned at the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: On bingxu day deposed the crown prince as commoner and imprisoned him at the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 己丑，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On jichou day Uighur came with tribute.
units.literal: On jichou day Uighur came with tribute.

units.zh: 殺東京留守同知耶律回裏不。
units.en: Eastern Capital regent associate administrator Yelü Huilibu was killed.
units.literal: Killed Eastern Capital regent associate administrator Yelü Huilibu.

units.zh: 辛卯，殺速撒等諸子，籍其家。
units.en: On xinmao day Susa's sons were killed and their households were registered.
units.literal: On xinmao day killed Susa's sons and registered their households.

units.zh: 戊申，遣使按五京諸道獄。
units.en: On wushen day envoys were dispatched to investigate prisons in the Five Capitals and all routes.
units.literal: On wushen day dispatched envoys to investigate prisons in the Five Capitals and all routes.

units.zh: 秋七月辛亥，護衛太保查剌加鎮國大將軍，預突呂不部節度使之選，室韋查剌及蕭寶神奴、謀魯古並加左衛大將軍，牌印郎君訛都斡尚皇女趙國公主，授駙馬都尉、始平軍節度使，祗候郎君耶律撻不也及蕭圖古辭並加監門衛上將軍。
units.en: On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, was appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.

units.zh: 壬子，知北院樞密副使蕭韓家奴為漢人行宮都部署。
units.en: On renzi day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
units.literal: On renzi day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.

units.zh: 乙丑，如秋山。
units.en: On yichou day the court went to autumn mountains.
units.literal: On yichou day went to autumn mountains.

units.zh: 丁丑，謁慶陵。
units.en: On dingchou day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
units.literal: On dingchou day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 八月庚寅，漢人行宮都部署蕭韓家奴薨。
units.en: On gengyin day of the eighth month Han mobile palace deployment director Xiao Hanjianu died.
units.literal: Eighth month, on gengyin day Han mobile palace deployment director Xiao Hanjianu died.

units.zh: 辛丑，謁慶陵。
units.en: On xinchou day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
units.literal: On xinchou day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 九月癸亥，玉田貢嘉禾。
units.en: On guihai day of the ninth month Yutian presented auspicious grain.
units.literal: Ninth month, on guihai day Yutian presented auspicious grain.

units.zh: 壬申，修乾陵廟。
units.en: On renshen day Qian Mausoleum temple was repaired.
units.literal: On renshen day repaired Qian Mausoleum temple.

units.zh: 冬十月辛丑，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: On xinchou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinchou day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 十一月，北院樞密使耶律乙辛遣其私人盜殺庶人浚於上京。
units.en: In the eleventh month Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin dispatched his private agents to assassinate the commoner Jun at the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: Eleventh month, Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin dispatched his private agents to assassinate the commoner Jun at the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 閏十二月戊午，以北府宰相遼西郡王蕭餘里也知北院樞密使事，左夷離畢耶律燕哥為契丹行宮都部署。
units.en: In the intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
units.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

units.zh: 丙寅，預行正旦禮。
units.en: On bingyin day New Year's rites were performed in advance.
units.literal: On bingyin day New Year's rites were performed in advance.

units.zh: 是歲，南京大熟。
units.en: That year Nanjing had a great harvest.
units.literal: That year Nanjing had a great harvest.

units.zh: 四年春正月庚辰，如春水。
units.en: In the fourth year, on gengchen day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on gengchen day, went to spring waters.

units.zh: 甲午，振東京饑。
units.en: On jiawu day famine in the Eastern Capital was relieved.
units.literal: On jiawu day relieved famine in the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 二月乙丑，駐蹕掃獲野。
units.en: On yichou day of the second month the court halted at Saohuoye.
units.literal: Second month, on yichou day, halted at Saohuoye.

units.zh: 戊辰，以東路統軍使耶律王九為惕隱。
units.en: On wuchen day Eastern Route supreme commander Yelü Wangjiu was made tiyin.
units.literal: On wuchen day Eastern Route supreme commander Yelü Wangjiu was made tiyin.

units.zh: 夏四月辛亥，高麗遣使乞賜鴨淥江以東地，不許。
units.en: On xinhai day of the fourth summer month Goryeo sent envoys begging grant of lands east of the Yalu River; permission was refused.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinhai day Goryeo dispatched envoys begging grant of lands east of the Yalu River; not permitted.

units.zh: 五月丙戌，駐蹕散水原。
units.en: On bingxu day of the fifth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
units.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day, halted at Sanshui Plain.

units.zh: 六月甲寅，阻卜諸酋長進良馬。
units.en: On jiayin day of the sixth month Zubu tribal chiefs presented fine horses.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin day Zubu tribal chiefs presented fine horses.

units.zh: 秋七月甲戌，諸路奏飯僧尼三十六萬。
units.en: On jiaxu day of the seventh autumn month all routes memorialized feeding three hundred sixty thousand monks and nuns.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiaxu day all routes memorialized feeding three hundred sixty thousand monks and nuns.

units.zh: 八月癸卯，詔有司決滯獄。
units.en: On guimao day of the eighth month an edict ordered the relevant offices to decide delayed cases.
units.literal: Eighth month, on guimao day, edict ordered the relevant offices to decide delayed cases.

units.zh: 九月乙未，駐蹕藕絲澱。
units.en: On yiwei day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
units.literal: Ninth month, on yiwei day, halted at Ousi Marsh.

units.zh: 庚子，五國部長來貢。
units.en: On gengzi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
units.literal: On gengzi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

units.zh: 冬十月癸卯，以參知政事劉伸為保靜軍節度使。
units.en: On guimao day of the tenth winter month Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made military commissioner of Baojing Army.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on guimao day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made military commissioner of Baojing Army.

units.zh: 十一月丁亥，禁士庶服用錦綺、日月、山龍之文。
units.en: On dinghai day of the eleventh month scholars and commoners were forbidden to wear brocade and silk with sun, moon, mountain, and dragon designs.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on dinghai day forbidden scholars and commoners to wear brocade and silk with sun, moon, mountain, and dragon designs.

units.zh: 己丑，回鶻遣使來貢。
units.en: On jichou day Uighur sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On jichou day Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 庚寅，南院樞密使耶律仲禧為廣德軍節度使。
units.en: On gengyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhongxi was made military commissioner of Guangde Army.
units.literal: On gengyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhongxi was made military commissioner of Guangde Army.

units.zh: 辛卯，錦州民張寶四世同居，命諸子三班院祗候。
units.en: On xinmao day Jin Prefecture commoner Zhang Bao's four generations lived together; his sons were ordered attendants of the Third Class Court.
units.literal: On xinmao day Jin Prefecture commoner Zhang Bao's four generations lived together; his sons were ordered attendants of the Third Class Court.

units.zh: 十二月丁卯，以北院樞密副使耶律霂知北院樞密使事。
units.en: On dingmao day of the twelfth month Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Li was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao day Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Li was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
